thread:
maya (PM): quick kickoff — we need a crisp scope for the Optimize Toolkit sprint. batching, caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts. who has hard constraints vs nice-to-have?
jon (ML Eng): must-have: eval-triggered alerts that can map to prompt sets and model-version diffs. customers will flag regressions fast.
sasha (Infra Eng): agree. infra ask: KV cache telemetry + per-tenant hit-rate heatmaps. without that ops can't tune cache TTLs.
alex (SRE): rollout concerns: can we define fallback policy in advance? if quantized path fails we should auto-fallback to float variant. also need canary for batching config changes.
priya (Product): customer note — AcmeHealth and FinanceCo asked for audit logs for eval alerts and a suppression window. that's a gating acceptance for Private deployments.
ben (ML Research): quantization recommendations should be workload-aware: give a safe default profile + guidance for edge workloads (long-context, retrieval-heavy). auto-quantization can be M2.
jon (ML Eng): +1 to workload profiles. for batching: provide a policy editor with latency targets + max batch size. runtime can enforce continuous batching heuristics.
sasha (Infra Eng): implementation risk: unified batching UI -> needs router + capacity hints in Dedicated. estimate 2 sprint infra work to expose hints.
maya (PM): tradeoff note: if we prioritize infra work now, we delay quant guide. what's the minimum viable acceptance criteria for launch (MVP)?
alex (SRE): MVP acceptance (proposal): 1) eval alerts pipeline that surfaces top-10 regressed prompts, 2) KV cache with per-tenant metrics and TTL tuning UI, 3) batching policy UI that can set p99 latency guardrails, 4) quant recommendations doc + checklists (no auto-deploy).
priya (Product): that sounds reasonable. add: audit log for alerts + suppression window = gating for Private customers.
ben (ML Research): sample rule for eval-alerts (proto):
```yaml
alert: prompt_regression
condition:
  delta_f1_pct: > 5
  sample_size: 50
actions:
  notify: # slack + console
  attach: top_k_prompts
  metadata: model_version, dataset_tag
```
jon (ML Eng): linking to the minimal telemetry spec I used for a pilot: <https://redwood.internal/telemetry/optimize-eval-spec>
devex-bot: Created checklist: Optimize Toolkit MVP -> https://redwood.atlassian.org/browse/OPT-1271 (owners: maya, jon, sasha) :white_check_mark:
maya (PM): ok next steps: - eng owners to list tech deps by EOD tomorrow, - priya to confirm customer gating list, - ben to draft quant recommendations doc (1 pager). we'll freeze M1 scope after that.
jon (ML Eng): I'll surface runtime knobs + estimated perf delta for 4 quant profiles (int8, q4_0, q4_1, nf4) by EOD.
sasha (Infra Eng): I'll post infra task list and rough ETA for capacity-hints and cache metrics.
priya (Product): I'll ping AcmeHealth legal for audit log requirements.
maya (PM): consensus for the sprint: freeze on Alex's MVP list. defer auto-quantization, per-model dynamic selection, and advanced econ advisor to M2. :thumbsup:
alex (SRE): noted. setting up canary playbook draft.
ben (ML Research): drafting quant recs now — will include dos & don'ts for retrieval-heavy flows.
maya (PM): thanks all. follow-ups in the checklist link. if anyone hits blockers, drop them here and we'll triage. :rocket:
